reading.body:
DFW-04 sits on a 44-acre campus in Plano separate from Aligned's smaller DFW-01 and DFW-02 facilities in the same city. The operator publishes no IT capacity, power draw, or square footage for this building, so its size relative to other AI infrastructure cannot be determined from available sources. It is designed to Tier III standards, which qualifies it to host workloads requiring redundant power and cooling systems but no active-active infrastructure.

Aligned Data Centers operates 50 campuses and has announced over 5 GW of operational and planned capacity across the United States and Latin America. Texas hosts 133 mapped facilities in the registry, of which 18 have published power figures totaling 468 MW. DFW-04 does not appear in that published total because no megawatt figure is disclosed. The operator was subject to an announced acquisition agreement with AIP, MGX, and BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners for approximately 40 billion dollars, expected to close in the first half of 2026, though this site has not independently confirmed the deal has closed.

Without published capacity, DFW-04 cannot be ranked against other AI-relevant campuses or weighted in assessments of grid constraint in Texas. The facility exists in a known operator's portfolio and on a substantial acreage, but its relevance to AI infrastructure scaling depends on operational capacity figures the operator has chosen not to disclose.
